title: OpenSky Route Diversity by Day
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=adsb:aircraft
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(route) as route_count by _time
| sort - route_count
description: Uses OpenSky route snapshots telemetry to monitor how many distinct routes passed through view each day in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for especially busy air-traffic days worth correlating with noise or spotting notes, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OpenSky route snapshots data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how many distinct routes passed through view each day so you can spot especially busy air-traffic days worth correlating with noise or spotting notes before it becomes annoying.
